claims.text: Boston City Council agenda included a resolution supporting a local option for rent stabilization, housing affordability, and tenant stability; the action was tabled.

citation.quote:
Resolution in support of a proposed local option for rent stabilization, housing affordability, and tenant stability.
Action: Tabled.

claims.text: New England Realty Associates owns and leases 19 condominium units in metropolitan Boston, Massachusetts.

citation.quote: The Partnership owns and leases to residential tenants 19 Condominium Units in the metropolitan Boston area of Massachusetts.

claims.text: New England Realty Associates owns a 52-unit mixed-use property in Boston's South End, with 7,299 square feet of commercial space.

citation.quote: On July 14, 2023, the Partnership purchased a 52 unit mixed use property in the South End neighborhood of Boston, MA comprised of three buildings at 26-30 Rutland Street, 105-117 West Concord Street and 475 Shawmut Avenue, and 7,299 square feet of commercial space
